title: Workcenter Config
description: Validates a Workcenter configuration file against all supported options

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, used by external editors for validation and autocompletion. Ignored by Workcenter

pages.title: Page List
pages.description: List of additional config files to load as extra pages

path.title: Path
path.description: The file name, or path. If in public directory, use just `file-name.yml`

displayData.title: Display Data
displayData.description: Optional meta data for customizing a page

hideForUsers.title: Hide for Users
hideForUsers.description: Page will be visible to all users, except for those specified in this list

items.description: Username for the user that will not be able to view this page

showForUsers.title: Show for Users
showForUsers.description: Page will be hidden from all users, except for those specified in this list

items.description: Username for the user that will have access to this page

hideForGuests.title: Hide for Guests?
hideForGuests.description: If set to true, page will be visible for logged in users, but not for guests

showForGroups.title: Show for Groups
showForGroups.description: Page will be hidden from all users except those with one or more of these SSO groups

items.description: Name of the group that will be able to view this page

hideForGroups.title: Hide for Groups
hideForGroups.description: Page will be hidden from users with any of these SSO groups

items.description: Name of the group that will not be able to view this page

showForRoles.title: Show for Roles
showForRoles.description: Page will be hidden from all users except those with one or more of these SSO roles

items.description: Name of the role that will be able to view this page

hideForRoles.title: Hide for Roles
hideForRoles.description: Page will be hidden from users with any of these SSO roles

items.description: Name of the role that will not be able to view this page

showForKeycloakUsers.title: Show for Groups/Roles (legacy)
showForKeycloakUsers.description: Legacy form of showForGroups and showForRoles

hideForKeycloakUsers.title: Hide for Groups/Roles (legacy)
hideForKeycloakUsers.description: Legacy form of hideForGroups and hideForRoles

title.title: Title
title.description: Title and heading for the app

navLinks.title: Navigation Links
navLinks.description: Quick access links, displayed in header

target.title: Opening Method
target.description: Where / how the item is opened when it's clicked

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: Content to display within the global page footer. Supports inline HTML (sanitized before render).

logo.title: App Logo
logo.description: Path to an optional image asset, to be displayed in the header

favicon.title: Favicon
favicon.description: URL or path to a custom favicon shown in the browser tab. Absolute (https://...), root-relative (/icons/x.png), or a data: URI.

color.title: Theme Color
color.description: Color applied to the browser chrome (mobile address bar). Any valid CSS color value.

defaultOpeningMethod.title: Default Opening Method
defaultOpeningMethod.description: The default opening method for items. Only used if no item.target is specified

language.title: Language
language.description: The ISO code of your desired language, must have translations present, check docs for more info

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: A theme to be applied by default on first load

dayTheme.title: Day Theme
dayTheme.description: Theme to apply when the OS is set to light mode. Overrides theme on initial load

nightTheme.title: Night Theme
nightTheme.description: Theme to apply when the OS is set to dark mode. Overrides theme on initial load

backgroundImg.title: Background Image
backgroundImg.description: A URL to an image asset to be displayed as background

faviconApi.title: Favicon API
faviconApi.description: Which service to use to resolve favicons. Set to local to do this locally instead

defaultIcon.title: Default Icon
defaultIcon.description: An icon to apply to any items which don't yet have the icon set

contentMaxWidth.title: Content Max Width
contentMaxWidth.description: Max width of the main sections area on the homepage. Pass as a percentage or CSS unit. Leave blank for the responsive default

workspaceLandingUrl.title: Workspace Landing URL
workspaceLandingUrl.description: The URL of the application pane to open when Workcenter loads, for example `https://filebrowser.example.com`. If it matches an item in the sidebar, that section is expanded.

customCss.title: Custom CSS
customCss.description: Any custom CSS overides to be applied globally, should be minified

enableGuestAccess.title: Enable Guest Mode?
enableGuestAccess.description: If set to true, an unauthenticated user will be able to have read-only access to dashboard, without needing to login. Requires auth to be configured.

logoutRedirectUrl.title: Logout Redirect URL
logoutRedirectUrl.description: If set, the logout button will redirect here after logging out. Useful with header auth / to end auth proxy session

users.title: Users
users.description: Usernames and hashed credentials for frontend authentication. Needs to be set at build-time.

hash.title: Hashed Pass
hash.description: A SHA-256 hashed password for that user

password.title: Password
password.description: The environmental variable pointing to a plaintext password for that user. Must start with VITE_APP_

type.title: Privileges
type.description: User type, denoting privilege level, either admin or normal

enableOidc.title: Enable OIDC?
enableOidc.description: If set to true, enable OIDC. See appConfig.auth.oidc

adminRole.title: Admin Role
adminRole.description: The role that will be considered as admin. If not set, no roles will be considered as admin

adminGroup.title: Admin Group
adminGroup.description: The group that will be considered as admin. If not set, no groups will be considered as admin

scope.title: OIDC Scope
scope.description: The scope(s) to request from the OIDC provider

showLoginPage.title: Show Workcenter's Login Page
showLoginPage.description: If set to true, signed-out users are shown Workcenter's login page (with sign-in and guest buttons), instead of being redirected straight to the OIDC provider

enableSilentRenew.title: Enable Silent Token Renewal
enableSilentRenew.description: If set to true, Workcenter automatically renews your session in the background before it expires. Requires your OIDC provider to issue refresh tokens

postLogoutRedirectUri.title: Post-Logout Redirect URI
postLogoutRedirectUri.description: URL to send users back to after logging out at the OIDC provider. Must be registered as a valid post-logout redirect URI with your provider

allowedIssuers.title: Allowed Token Issuers
allowedIssuers.description: List of issuer URLs to accept tokens from, overriding the issuer in the discovery document. Only needed for multi-tenant providers where the token issuer differs from the configured endpoint

disableServerSideCheck.title: Disable Server-Side Check
disableServerSideCheck.description: If set to true, the server skips token verification and endpoint protection, making OIDC client-side only. Not recommended

enableHeaderAuth.title: Enable HeaderAuth?
enableHeaderAuth.description: If set to true, enable Header Authentication. See appConfig.auth.headerAuth

proxyWhitelist.title: Upstream Proxy Auth Trust
proxyWhitelist.description: Upstream proxy servers to expect authenticated requests from

items.description: IPs of upstream proxies that will be trusted

enableKeycloak.title: Enable Keycloak?
enableKeycloak.description: If set to true, and auth.keycloak is also configured, then Keycloak will be used for app auth

serverUrl.title: Server URL
serverUrl.description: The URL (or URL/ IP + Port) where your keycloak server is running

realm.title: Realm
realm.description: The name of the realm (must already be created) that you want to use

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: The Client ID of the client you created for use with Workcenter

idpHint.title: IdP hint
idpHint.description: Set to the 'Alias' of an existing Identity Provider in the specified realm to skip the Keycloak login page and redirect straight to the external IdP for authentication

adminRole.title: Admin Role
adminRole.description: The realm or client role that grants admin privileges (mapped into realm_access.roles in the id_token). If not set, no roles will be considered admin.

adminGroup.title: Admin Group
adminGroup.description: The group claim value that grants admin privileges. Requires a Keycloak mapper that puts a 'groups' claim into the id_token. If not set, no groups will be considered admin.

legacySupport.title: Legacy Support
legacySupport.description: If using Keycloak 17 or older, then set this to true

enableServiceWorker.title: Enable Service Worker
enableServiceWorker.description: If set to true, then service workers will be used to cache page contents

enableAuthProxyCompat.title: Enable Auth Proxy Compatibility
enableAuthProxyCompat.description: If set to true, when an authentication proxy (e.g. Cloudflare Zero Trust, Authelia) redirects after session expiry, the service worker is unregistered and the page reloaded so the login redirect can proceed. Only relevant when enableServiceWorker is true

enableErrorReporting.title: Enable Error Reporting
enableErrorReporting.description: Enable anonymous crash reports. This helps bugs be found and fixed, in order to make Workcenter more stable. Reporting is off by default, and no data will EVER be collected without your explicit and active concent.

sentryDsn.title: Custom Sentry DSN
sentryDsn.description: The DSN to your self-hosted Sentry server, if you need to collect bug reports. Only used if enableErrorReporting is enabled

iconSize.title: Icon Size
iconSize.description: The default size for icons in the sidebar and the page title.

enableFontAwesome.title: Enable Font Awesome
enableFontAwesome.description: Inject the Font Awesome kit. Leave unset to inject it only when an `fa-` icon is used.

enableMaterialDesignIcons.title: Enable Material Design Icons
enableMaterialDesignIcons.description: Inject the Material Design Icons stylesheet. Leave unset to inject it only when an `mdi-` icon is used.

fontAwesomeKey.title: Font Awesome Kit ID
fontAwesomeKey.description: Your Font Awesome kit ID. Only needed when icons use Font Awesome glyphs.

cssThemes.title: CSS Themes
cssThemes.description: Additional CSS files to offer as themes, relative to the web root.

customColors.title: Custom Colors
customColors.description: Override individual theme colour variables, for example `primary` or `background`.

externalStyleSheet.title: External Stylesheet
externalStyleSheet.description: A stylesheet URL to load in addition to the theme.

hideComponents.title: Hide Components
hideComponents.description: Hide individual shell components. Each key is a component name and each value a boolean.

name.title: Section Name
name.description: Title/ heading for a section. Required and must be unique

icon.title: Section Icon
icon.description: Icon will be displayed next to title

displayData.title: Display Data
displayData.description: Optional meta data for customizing a section

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: How to sort items within the section. By default items are displayed in the order in which they are listed in within the config

collapsed.title: Is Collapsed?
collapsed.description: If true, section needs to be clicked to open

cutToHeight.title: Cut to Height
cutToHeight.description: By default, sections will fill available space. Set this option to true to match section height with content height

color.title: Color
color.description: Hex code, or HTML color for section fill

itemSize.title: Item Size
itemSize.description: Size of items within the section

rows.title: Num Rows
rows.description: The amount of space that the section spans vertically (applies to the default 'auto' layout; ignored by 'masonry' where heights follow content)

cols.title: Num Cols
cols.description: The amount of space that the section spans horizontally

sectionLayout.title: Layout Type
sectionLayout.description: If set to grid, items have uniform width, and itemCount can be set

hideForUsers.title: Hide for Users
hideForUsers.description: Section will be visible to all users, except for those specified in this list

items.description: Username for the user that will not be able to view this section

showForUsers.title: Show for Users
showForUsers.description: Section will be hidden from all users, except for those specified in this list

items.description: Username for the user that will have access to this section

hideForGuests.title: Hide for Guests?
hideForGuests.description: If set to true, section will be visible for logged in users, but not for guests

showForGroups.title: Show for Groups
showForGroups.description: Section will be hidden from all users except those with one or more of these SSO groups

items.description: Name of the group that will be able to view this section

hideForGroups.title: Hide for Groups
hideForGroups.description: Section will be hidden from users with any of these SSO groups

items.description: Name of the group that will not be able to view this section

showForRoles.title: Show for Roles
showForRoles.description: Section will be hidden from all users except those with one or more of these SSO roles

items.description: Name of the role that will be able to view this section

hideForRoles.title: Hide for Roles
hideForRoles.description: Section will be hidden from users with any of these SSO roles

items.description: Name of the role that will not be able to view this section

hideFromWorkspace.title: Hide from Workspace
hideFromWorkspace.description: When true, this section and its items are not listed in the Workcenter sidebar. Defaults to `false`.

items.title: Items
items.description: Array of items to display with a section

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description, shown on hover or in a tooltip

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: An icon, either as a font-awesome, simple-icon, selfh.st, or mdi identifier, emoji, favicon, generative or the URL/path to a local or remote icon asset

url.title: Service URL
url.description: The destination to navigate to when item is clicked, expressed as a valid URL, IP or hostname

localUrl.title: Local URL
localUrl.description: Optional alternative URL preferred when it is reachable from your browser (e.g. a LAN address)

localUrlTimeout.title: Local URL Probe Timeout
localUrlTimeout.description: For local URLs, ms to wait for the Local URL reachability probe before falling back to normal URL

localUrlCheckInterval.title: Local URL Re-check Interval
localUrlCheckInterval.description: For local URLs, seconds between background re-checks of the Local URL. 0 = only check on page load

displayData.title: Display Data
displayData.description: Optional meta data for customizing an item

hideForUsers.title: Hide for Users
hideForUsers.description: Item will be visible to all users, except for those specified in this list

items.description: Username for the user that will not be able to view this item

showForUsers.title: Show for Users
showForUsers.description: Item will be hidden from all users, except for those specified in this list

items.description: Username for the user that will have access to this item

hideForGuests.title: Hide for Guests?
hideForGuests.description: If set to true, item will be visible for logged in users, but not for guests

showForGroups.title: Show for Groups
showForGroups.description: Item will be hidden from all users except those with one or more of these SSO groups

items.description: Name of the group that will be able to view this item

hideForGroups.title: Hide for Groups
hideForGroups.description: Item will be hidden from users with any of these SSO groups

items.description: Name of the group that will not be able to view this item

showForRoles.title: Show for Roles
showForRoles.description: Item will be hidden from all users except those with one or more of these SSO roles

items.description: Name of the role that will be able to view this item

hideForRoles.title: Hide for Roles
hideForRoles.description: Item will be hidden from users with any of these SSO roles

items.description: Name of the role that will not be able to view this item

hideFromWorkspace.title: Hide from Workspace
hideFromWorkspace.description: When true, this item is not listed in the Workcenter sidebar. Defaults to `false`.

target.title: Opening Method
target.description: Where / how the item is opened when it's clicked

hotkey.title: Hot Key
hotkey.description: A numeric shortcut key, between 0 and 9. Useful for quickly launching frequently used applications

rel.title: rel
rel.description: The rel attribute for the link. For specifying the relationship between the current document and the linked document

id.title: Item ID
id.description: Unique ID for each item. Generated automatically, shouldn't need to be set manually.

subItems.title: Sub-Items
subItems.description: Optional list of nested sub-items, displayed as smaller icons within the parent item. Each sub-item supports the same core fields as a regular item

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the sub-item, shown in the tooltip

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL to open when the sub-item is clicked

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: The icon for the sub-item. Supports the same icon types as a regular item

target.title: Target
target.description: The opening method for the sub-item

color.title: Color
color.description: An optional color for the sub-item icon

backgroundColor.title: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: An optional background color for the sub-item

color.title: Colour
color.description: A CSS colour override for this item in the sidebar.

backgroundColor.title: Background Colour
backgroundColor.description: A CSS background colour for this item in the sidebar, for example `#ffffff1a`.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: The name of the service behind this item, shown as context in the sidebar.
